note: rg or grep with NO PATH argument hangs a subagent shell forever, and neither ListAgents nor task notifications can see it. A Warrant subagent ran rg -n PATTERN --glob EXCLUDE piped to head, with no path. rg with no path reads STDIN, and a subagent shell stdin is an open pipe rather than EOF, so it blocked. The subagent reported DONE and completed; its orphaned shell ran 7h36m as a child of the claude process and was noticed by the human, not by me. Every subagent showed completed and every background-task notification had arrived, so neither instrument sees an orphaned shell and nothing reaps it. SPOT IT with ps -eo pid,ppid,etime,command filtered to children of the claude pid, looking for a long ELAPSED on a shell whose subagent has finished. AVOID IT by always passing an explicit path, as in rg PATTERN dot. Sibling of the documented agent-stdin-is-EOF trap in the opposite direction: there a stdin-reading command returns instantly for the agent and hangs the human, here it hangs the agent. Same cause, that an agent shell stdin is neither a terminal nor reliably closed. SECOND TRAP, hit while posting this: make board-post NOTE runs through a shell, so a literal pipe character in the note aborts the post.
